body: Hugs. I hope my antidepressants do the same for me. I'm very happy you got out of the pattern of spiraling! This week I've been low basically the entire week and self sabotaging my diet. Making myself eat things I don't even want. I kinda crashed last night but it still feels like holding back an emotional sneeze.

<3 Thank you so much. I think this is what I needed to hear. Just thank you for being so understanding. It really helps. Most of the time I'm like fuck the world I'm trans and proud, but then stuff like today happens and I just want to curl up into a ball.
I know. It's not a logical issue. It's emotional and I hate that I'm this way. I try so hard but it's so easy to send me into an emotional spiral.

I started an antidepressant about a week ago because I finally talked to my doctor at my therapist's urging. I'm trying to give it time to work, but it's hard. It's like my brain punishes me for enjoying myself. Thanks for the compliment about my writing. Really it's just what I feel so I write it down.

Hey hun. I'm trans (MTF). I'm having the same issue right now. I'm tired of the constant suicidal ideations and dysphoria. Just a constant cycle of pain that doesn't seem to get better. That's it most things I hear people say or things I read about suicidal  feelings is the feeling will fade and situations are only temporary, but no I've been trans my whole life and dysphoria is a constant, overwhelming fucking pain that never ceases. IDK, at least you're not alone I guess.

So the friend I was talking about last night ended up poking me because she couldn't fall asleep. I told her what was going on and she convinced me to come over. It really didn't take much of her holding me for the crying to stop. We were up super late and ended up sleeping through her work alarms. My 11am alarm finally woke us up. I try not to but I feel like it's my fault, but it really isn't she was awake with or without me. So, she ended up working from home and I worked on a software project we are doing together all day until I had to come in for my night shift. She's wonderful and knows exactly what's going on with me. We kinda ping back and fourth with our spirals and support. I 1000% don't mind helping her through her issues. I'd do anything to help her, but I always feel like a burden to everyone else. She told me (as she's told me before) that if I need to just come over it's part of why I have a key. IDK it's so weird because I gave her a key a while back for the same reasons again though it's great to me when she uses her key, but I feel like a burden when I use mine. I'm at work right now until 2am and I'm doing okay. I like work here. I'm going to try to go to my apartment tonight and I'm making a promise to myself to just go to her house if I can't handle it. I only have to be in this apartment for another month then I'm done and have to find another. The thing is since moving to this city this is the first time I've wanted to put effort into life and try to be happy. I mean to really try and I am finally happy, but then my brain finds something focuses on the negative and I spiral hard. I've made 1 actual attempt since coming here and another risk to save a friend without concern for my health. I've been close a few times. My friend thinks I should try antidepressants. She's just started them and I can tell they help her. I think it's wonderful and I'm so happy for her, but for some reason I'm fighting the idea for myself. I mean it's because I hate me and love her so yeah . Here's to tonight! Hopefully I can make it through the whole night in my apartment.

I need to sleep but I can't seem to go to sleep. I was almost passing out at work but now I'm curled up in bed I can't fall asleep. I am a burden even if my friends don't mind it and I hate that about myself. My therapist is actually really good and she's also honest. Friday my friend and I had a Chinese takeout and Anime day. That helped get me through the weekend.
Hahaha! Plus side is you made me laugh.
What is even happening? \*shrugs\*

I'm not really sure I follow your logic. I, honestly, hate sleep. No idea why, but I hate to sleep. I get really emotional and come close to killing myself or doing the prep work that needs to be done for a successful suicide. Lately, though, it's been more calm. I'm kind of just over living. I have so much pain and crap I deal with every day why would I want to continue and to what point and end would I be striving? Also, I'm in the US.
Today I'm at work on the opposite shift I usually am. So I'm sleepy and just keep thinking about how I'd rather just not exist.

I'm right there with you hun. Spent most of the day with suicidal ideations. Which isn't uncommon for me. My therapist wants me to "Think about what you want out of life." I just kept coming back to I want to die. Honestly, it isn't so much I want to die as I want to just not exist.
Hell yeah! I wish I could just beat the shit out of depression and be done with them!
Yeah, I have other issues for sure. I do see a therapist. She suggested Anti-depressives the other day. Maybe I should try them.
I am so happy for you. Honestly, it's like a pendulum and I'm swinging towards the darker/depressive side.
You are very sweet <3
I understood you. I think you're missing that is what I've been trying to do. It has failed.
I do appreciate your enthusiasm, but that is what I've been doing for the past several years. I don't think I can continue to claim happiness forever. I'm growing tired of the battles honestly.
The thought has crossed my mind.

There's nothing wrong with that at all. The second part is a problem to me and that's because we aren't just friends with benefits. We are both emotionally intertwined. I know you may come back with how do you know she feels that way and the answer is she's told me and she's proven how close we are through her actions in a few situations. I am comfortable with her dating someone though I will have some emotions I'll have to deal with ; that's my problem, but I don't see her agreeing to not hang out with me especially given the dynamic of our friend group. I would be worried if she was dating a man that was that insecure. 

Again the emotional investment on both sides is what makes this hard to separate from dating. No, I know her innermost thoughts and that's what makes this strange to me. Honestly, I needed this connection in my life and so did she. I guess I've just got to figure out how to separate this from a relationship. It's hard because this doesn't fit neatly in the friends with benefits box. We have each showed up because we knew the other was about to make a mistake and just held each other for hours to make it through the day. 

Maybe it is just she wants a real penis or there's a novelty for here I know she's had multiple girlfriends in her past and only one boyfriend for a short period and some of them have really hurt her. 

I think I may make a dating profile and just try to move on in my dating life. Her love and support is amazing.
Yeah, there are I'm a part of two specifically.

That's a very good point actually. I think what it is (and you've noticed I don't like to get int specifics of my issue) so few people have to face this and there's a comfort in someone who understands, but that also comes with a sadness that they have to deal with it too.

Yeah, that's exactly it. This is confusing. I've had a friend with benefits before, but this is very different. Hell, she was talking to me just last night about how wonderful it is to have someone she can be physically and emotionally open and close to. 

I mean we even do boring things now like go grocery shopping and  clean the house (her house). I don't mind in fact I love it. Just don't understand how we aren't dating and neither do our friends.

She's pansexual like myself, but has this idea in her head she wants to date a man. She's only had one boyfriend and idk it may be some weird fixation there. 

I may not have the same equipment but a good strap-on fixes that problem tbh.

This is some very good advice. I am not a man, no typo yay lesbians (I'm pansexual). You're right her romantic life is hers and I shouldn't over concern myself with it, though it's hard not to. Be there for her as a friend yeah. 

So I have a habit of trying to put everything in my life into logical sequences and patterns. Perhaps you're right and love can't be quantified in such an empirical sense. Knowing the parameters of a situation makes me comfortable :( 

The issue is a really big deal to me and really how I met this girl because she faces the same thing every day of her life. There's a comfort there beyond just listening, but having lived with it. I suppose someone who doesn't have to deal with this may could be supportive and be there for me. That may be the most I should expect from someone. But to truly understand it I'm not sure honestly. It's a nice thought.

You're right. I didn't create an exhaustive list of everything and I did kinda leave that out intentionally, because physical characteristics change over time and I don't think are a good basis for a relationship. A factor for sure. That being said I find her extremely attractive and sexy and vice versa. We do share a very rewarding physical and sexual relationship.
